info.name: OCI Control Center Capacity Management API
A GET call to list overview of resources in a given time interval

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace by which we would filter the list.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ocid of the compartment or tenancy in which resources are to be listed. This will also be used for authorization purposes.

params.name: from
params.description: The month corresponding to this date would be considered as the starting point of the time period against which we would like to perform an aggregation.

params.name: to
params.description: The month corresponding to this date would be considered as the ending point of the time period against which we would like to perform an aggregation.

params.name: workloadType
params.description: Workload type using the resources in an availability catalog can be filtered.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. The default order for periodValue is chronological order(latest month item at the end).

items.docs: Lists an overview of all resources in that namespace in a given time interval.

info.name: A GET call to list occ handover resource blocks.

params.name: namespace
params.description: The namespace by which we would filter the list.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The OCID of the compartment or tenancy in which resources are to be listed.

params.name: handoverResourceName
params.description: A filter to return only the list of resources that match the name provided in this filter.

params.name: handoverDateGreaterThanOrEqualTo
params.description: This filter helps in fetching all handed over resources for which the recordDate is greater than or equal to the startDate.

params.name: handoverDateLessThanOrEqualTo
params.description: This filter helps in fetching all handed over resources for which the recordDate is less than or equal to the endDate.

params.name: occHandoverResourceBlockId
params.description: This filter helps in fetching the handed over resource for which the occHandoverResourceId is equal to the one provided here.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: A token representing the position at which to start retrieving results. This must come from `opc-next-page` header field of a previous response.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'ASC' or 'DESC'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. 
The default order for handoverDate is chronological order(latest date item at the end).
